UPLOAD_POST_PUBLISH_POST.description: Immediately publish one video, photo carousel, or text post to external connected platforms.

title.description: Post title or primary text. Required for text posts and for media platforms that require a title.

anyOf.title: FileUploadable
anyOf.description:
A file the caller hands IN. ``s3key`` is an S3/R2 reference (production) or a
base64 ``data:`` URL (self-hosted ``FILE_BACKEND=base64``) — the ``FileStore`` knows
which. Mirrors ``mercury/tools/files.py`` field-for-field.

video.description: Video file reference or public URL. Required only for a video post.

items.description:
A file the caller hands IN. ``s3key`` is an S3/R2 reference (production) or a
base64 ``data:`` URL (self-hosted ``FILE_BACKEND=base64``) — the ``FileStore`` knows
which. Mirrors ``mercury/tools/files.py`` field-for-field.

photos.description: Media files in carousel order. Instagram and Threads support mixed image/video carousels. Required only for a photo post.

platforms.description: Connected platform slugs compatible with content_type. Video supports tiktok, instagram, linkedin, youtube, facebook, x, threads, pinterest, bluesky, reddit, google_business, discord, and telegram. Photos support the same set except youtube. Text supports linkedin, x, facebook, threads, reddit, bluesky, google_business, discord, and telegram. TikTok publishing requires a paid plan.

subreddit.description: Target subreddit name without the r/ prefix.

description.description: Optional post caption or extended body text.

async_upload.description: Return a request ID immediately and publish in the background. A long synchronous upload may also fall back to async.

content_type.description: Post format; selects the video, photo carousel, or text publishing endpoint.

first_comment.description: First comment for platforms that support one.

idempotency_key.description: Caller-generated unique key that makes retries return the existing upload instead of creating a duplicate.

facebook_page_id.description: Facebook Page destination ID returned by LIST_PLATFORM_DESTINATIONS.

linkedin_page_id.description: LinkedIn organization destination ID returned by LIST_PLATFORM_DESTINATIONS.

profile_username.description: Existing Upload-Post profile username whose connected accounts publish the post.

pinterest_board_id.description: Pinterest board ID returned by LIST_PLATFORM_DESTINATIONS.

google_business_location_id.description: Google Business location name or ID returned by LIST_PLATFORM_DESTINATIONS.

TRELLO_UPDATE_BOARDS_BY_ID_BOARD.description: Updates attributes (e.g., name, description, status, preferences) of an existing Trello board identified by `idBoard`.

desc.description: New board description (max 16384 characters). An empty string removes the current description.

name.description: New name for the board (1-16384 characters).

closed.description: Set to 'true' to close (archive) the board, or 'false' to re-open.

idBoard.description: The ID of the Trello board to update.

subscribed.description: 'true' or 'false' for the authenticated user to be subscribed to the board.

prefs_voting.description: Voting permissions. Maps to API parameter 'prefs_voting'. Allowed values: `disabled`, `members`, `observers`, `org`, `public`.

idBoardSource.description: ID of an existing board to copy settings (e.g., lists, labels) from.

prefs__voting.description: Voting permissions. Maps to API parameter 'prefs/voting'. Allowed values: `disabled`, `members`, `observers`, `org`, `public`.

idOrganization.description: ID or name of the Trello Workspace to associate with this board.

keepFromSource.description: Comma-separated components to copy from `idBoardSource` (e.g., 'cards,labels', 'all'). Defaults to 'cards' if `idBoardSource` is set. Valid: `cards`, `lists`, `members`, `checklists`, `comments`, `labels`, `stickers`, `attachments`.

prefs_comments.description: Commenting permissions. Maps to API parameter 'prefs_comments'. Allowed values: `disabled`, `members`, `observers`, `org`, `public`.

prefs_selfJoin.description: Enables or disables self-join for Workspace members. Maps to API parameter 'prefs_selfJoin'. Set to 'true' or 'false'.

labelNames__red.description: Custom name for the red label (max 16384 chars). Maps to API parameter 'labelNames/red'.

prefs__comments.description: Commenting permissions. Maps to API parameter 'prefs/comments'. Allowed values: `disabled`, `members`, `observers`, `org`, `public`.

prefs__selfJoin.description: Enable or disable self-join for Workspace members. Maps to API parameter 'prefs/selfJoin'. Set to 'true' or 'false'.

prefs_cardAging.description: Card aging style. Maps to API parameter 'prefs_cardAging'. Allowed values: `pirate`, `regular`.

labelNames__blue.description: Custom name for the blue label (max 16384 chars). Maps to API parameter 'labelNames/blue'.

prefs__cardAging.description: Card aging style. Maps to API parameter 'prefs/cardAging'. Allowed values: `pirate`, `regular`.

prefs_background.description: Board background. Maps to API parameter 'prefs_background'. Can be a color name, a custom background ID, or a Trello photo ID. Max length: 16384 characters.

prefs_cardCovers.description: Enables or disables card covers. Maps to API parameter 'prefs_cardCovers'. Set to 'true' or 'false'.

labelNames__green.description: Custom name for the green label (max 16384 chars). Maps to API parameter 'labelNames/green'.

prefs__cardCovers.description: Enable or disable card covers. Maps to API parameter 'prefs/cardCovers'. Set to 'true' or 'false'.

prefs_invitations.description: Invitation permissions. Maps to API parameter 'prefs_invitations'. Allowed values: `admins`, `members`.

labelNames__orange.description: Custom name for the orange label (max 16384 chars). Maps to API parameter 'labelNames/orange'.

labelNames__purple.description: Custom name for the purple label (max 16384 chars). Maps to API parameter 'labelNames/purple'.

labelNames__yellow.description: Custom name for the yellow label (max 16384 chars). Maps to API parameter 'labelNames/yellow'.

prefs__invitations.description: Invitation permissions. Maps to API parameter 'prefs/invitations'. Allowed values: `admins`, `members`.

prefs_permissionLevel.description: Board's visibility and permission level. Maps to API parameter 'prefs_permissionLevel'. Allowed values: `org`, `private`, `public`.

prefs__permissionLevel.description: Board visibility and permission level. Maps to API parameter 'prefs/permissionLevel'. Allowed values: `org` (Workspace-visible), `private`, `public`.

prefs__calendarFeedEnabled.description: Enable or disable the iCalendar feed. Maps to API parameter 'prefs/calendarFeedEnabled'. Set to 'true' or 'false'.

LINKEDIN_CREATE_ARTICLE_OR_URL_SHARE.description: Tool to create an article or URL share on LinkedIn using the UGC Posts API. Use when you need to share a link with optional commentary on LinkedIn. Supports sharing URLs as articles with customizable visibility settings.

author.description: URN of the author (person or organization). For a person: 'urn:li:person:{id}'. For an organization: 'urn:li:organization:{id}'. Use GET_MY_INFO action to get your person ID.

com.linkedin.ugc.MemberNetworkVisibility.description: Visibility level for the post. Use 'PUBLIC' to make visible to everyone, 'CONNECTIONS' for connections only, or 'LOGGED_IN' for signed-in members.

visibility.description: Visibility settings for the post. Controls who can see the shared content.

lifecycleState.description: State of the post. Use 'PUBLISHED' to post immediately or 'DRAFT' to save as draft.

status.description: Status of the media. Use 'READY' for URL shares.

originalUrl.description: The URL to be shared. Must be a valid HTTP or HTTPS URL.

items.description: Media item for article or URL share.

media.description: Array of media items to share. For article/URL shares, include one MediaItem with the URL.

shareCommentary.description: Commentary text to accompany the shared URL. Required by the API even if empty (e.g. {'text': ''}). Should be a dict with 'text' key.

shareMediaCategory.description: Media category for the share. Use 'ARTICLE' for URL shares, 'NONE' for text-only posts.

com.linkedin.ugc.ShareContent.description: Share content configuration for article or URL shares.

specificContent.description: Container for the share content including URL, commentary, and media category.

LINKEDIN_CREATE_COMMENT_ON_POST.description: Tool to create a first-level or nested comment on a LinkedIn share, UGC post, or parent comment via the Social Actions Comments API. Use when you need to engage with posts by adding comments or replying to existing comments. Supports text comments with optional @-mentions and image attachments.

actor.description: Entity which authored the comment. For personal comments: 'urn:li:person:{id}'. For organization comments: 'urn:li:organization:{id}'. Use the GET_USER_INFO action to retrieve the 'id' field.

object.description: The URN of the share or ugcPost that contains the comment. Typically the same as target_urn for first-level comments, or the root post URN for nested comments. Must be 'urn:li:share:{id}' or 'urn:li:ugcPost:{id}'. Activity URNs ('urn:li:activity:{id}') are NOT supported.

urn.description: The URN of the image to attach to the comment (e.g., 'urn:li:image:C4D00AAAAbBCDEFGhiJ').

items.description:
Content entity for images or other media in the comment.

This action posts to LinkedIn's legacy /v2/socialActions comments endpoint (still functional,
though no longer documented by LinkedIn/Microsoft). That endpoint expects a flat 'urn' field
here, NOT the nested {'entity': {'image': ...}} shape used by LinkedIn's newer, versioned
/rest/socialActions Comments API - sending the newer shape here returns a 400 "Comment media
object must have either urn or image url, had neither" since the legacy endpoint doesn't
recognize it.

content.description: Array of content entities such as images to include in the comment. Each entity should contain an image URN or other content type.

text.description: The text content of the comment. Supports plain text and @-mentions.

start.description: Start position of the mention in the message text.

value.description: Contains the mention entity. For person mentions: {'person': 'urn:li:person:123'}. For organization mentions: {'organization': 'urn:li:organization:456'}.

length.description: Length of the mention text in the message.

attributes.description: Array of attributes for @-mentions in the comment text. Use this to mention specific people or organizations in the comment.

message.description: The comment message content including text and optional @-mentions.

target_urn.description: The URN of the share, UGC post, or parent comment where the comment will be created. Must be 'urn:li:share:{id}', 'urn:li:ugcPost:{id}', or 'urn:li:comment:({parentUrn},{commentId})'. Activity URNs ('urn:li:activity:{id}') are NOT supported.

parent_comment.description: For nested comments (replies), the URN of the parent comment being replied to. Format: 'urn:li:comment:({parentUrn},{commentId})'. Leave empty for first-level comments on the post.
